prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy field-biologist photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. At a volcanic plateau observatory above steaming fumaroles, she stands beside a calibrated range pole and records two separate creatures in one wide frame. Image 1 supplies visible-appearance guidance only for this original adult fictional woman. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use an elevated wide 3:2 documentary view that keeps her face readable and both creatures spatially separated, uncropped, full-body, and large enough to inspect every junction. On a basalt ledge, show a two-legged winged wyvern topology in a clear three-quarter landing view: one head neck torso and pelvis form one coherent creature body during landing; exactly two wings connect symmetrically near the shoulders during landing; exactly two weight-bearing hind legs descend from the pelvis onto basalt; the shoulder wings occupy the forelimb positions as the only front appendage pair on the chest; one long tail continues from the pelvis without branching through the landing arc. Farther downslope, show a grounded single-body multi-neck hydra: one torso pelvis and limb system anchors every neck on basalt; three or more complete neck paths remain visible from torso to head in clear silhouette; each neck has a distinct non-merged root on the same shoulder system across the broad back; each head retains a separate silhouette jaw and orientation against the dawn sky; feet body shadow and nearby objects preserve one coherent creature scale on the plateau. Her tablet, range pole, cold-dawn side light, contact shadows, and displaced ash make the survey action and scale immediately legible.
